articles.author: Piper Hudspeth Blackburn
articles.title: Trump shares map that renames New Mexico as ‘New America’ - CNN
articles.description: President Donald Trump on Sunday appeared to suggest that New Mexico should be called “New America,” posting a photo of the state with the new name days after he signed an executive order to change Lake Ontario to “Lake America.”
